statements.impact_statement: In `cookie` 0.14.0 up to 0.18.2 a private cookie encrypted in more than one process after a `fork()` could reuse an AES-GCM nonce. The operator console encrypts its session cookie with `cookie`'s private jar, through `ferrohealth-session`, in its one server process and never forks, so no released console image met the condition; the console takes `cookie` 0.18.3 from FerroTERM 0.4.8 on (#1275), where the advisory is fixed.
